description: Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base, paid automatically via x402 from X402_PRIVATE_KEY. Screen a crypto address (any chain: EVM/Base/Ethereum, Bitcoin, Tron, Solana and more, via OFAC's listed digital currency addresses) and/or a person or entity name (fuzzy, scored 0-100) against the official US Treasury OFAC SDN and Consolidated sanctions lists. Returns clear / match / possible_match, the matched entries (name, programs, aliases), list publish date, timestamp and sources. Use before sending funds to or onboarding a counterparty. Informational only, not legal or compliance advice. Failed calls (4xx/5xx) are not charged. Informational only, not investment advice.

address.description: Crypto address on any chain, e.g. 0x… (EVM), bc1…/1…/3… (Bitcoin), T… (Tron), base58 (Solana)

name.description: Person or entity name to screen (fuzzy match)
